programs.title: Border Patrol
programs.desc: The series reports on the everyday life of dedicated New Zealand customs officers, working around the clock at the country's borders.Their tasks include, among others:catching transports of drugs and other illegal items, or intercepting objects containing potentially dangerous diseases.The program's heroes also monitor people arriving in the country to prevent individuals whose presence is not welcome there from entering its territory.Viewers will find out what technology customs officers use and how trained animals support them.

programs.title: Genghis Khan: the Secret History of the Mongols
programs.desc: A profile of a man who went down in history as a brilliant military strategist.The six-episode series will present little-known facts from the life of the fearless leader.The authors will show how, after a difficult childhood and captivity, he managed to gain power, unite the quarreling tribes, build an invincible army and subjugate all those who opposed him, including his former allies.Impressive conquests will be discussed, including:expansion into the West, campaigns against the neighboring Tangut people and the Chinese Jin Empire.The troops he commanded were known for the mobility of their cavalry, carrying out rapid attacks and retreats, and applying psychological pressure on their opponents.They used innovative techniques when besieging even well-fortified cities.Genghis Khan became one of the most important figures in history, expanding his empire to unprecedented sizes.It stretched from the Pacific to the Caspian and Black Seas.The creators of the series are based on a new translation of the anonymous chronicle "The Secret History of the Mongols", which is the oldest known written monument of the steppe peoples of Central Asia.
